# Combined section: 02a-dacso-program-matching.R


## Documentation context


## 02a.4. DASCO Program Matching/CIP Coding Methodology


For DACSO data, we are able to do matching at the program level to compare CIP code data because there is more consistency in program names between STP and DACSO, as well as CPC codes to facilitate matching.  **If we find a program match between STP and DACSO, and the CIP codes differ, then we change the STP data to use the DACSO CIP code.**  There are no instances where we change the DACSO CIP code to match the STP CIP code if there is a difference. Our logic is that the DACSO data has more recent CIP code data (because of the time lag between when the STP data is pulled and sent to us, and when the DACSO program review and cohort loading happens.) Also the DACSO data undergoes the extensive program review to confirm the CIP codes. There is no need to make any CIP code changes in the DACSO data table. We only make CIP code changes for DACSO records in the STP data. Note that this is different from BGS where we sometimes change the STP CIP to match the BGS and vice versa, depending on which CIP we think is more appropriate/detailed etc.

## DASCO Program Matching/CIP Coding Steps

The first stage is to create a XWALK table with program data seen in the previous edition of the PSSM. Our logic is that we want to be able to re-use the program matching work done previously and then just determine what are the new program data/changed program data seen in the latest STP data. There can be quite a few changes each PSSM cycle because CIPs might change in STP, CIPs might change in DACSO, DACSO may have updated CPCs that should now be linked to historical program information (and this changes the historical matching), and there may be new programs seen in DACSO and/or STP. Those are the many types of changes that we need to identify and then use to update the XWALK table. Then we use the XWALK table to update STP DACSO program data and then case level data in STP with the final CIP information to use.

_**Note the abbreviation XWALK in this documentation is meant to represent the current year’s DACSO STP Programs CIP 4 XWALK table (e.g. DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2015_17)**_

### Create a new DACSO STP Program XWALK table

All the DACSO –STP program matching work done for the previous edition is in a “XWALK” table. Last year’s XWALK table will be the starting point for this year’s DACSO program matching work.

·         Open up the STP_OutcomesProgramMatching [[JKJ1]](#_msocom_1) Access database. There’s a shortcut from P:\PSSM\19-485-8 Post-Secondary Supply Model 2017-2018\Development\SQL Server\Outcomes Program Matching

o   Refresh the linked tables from Infoware

o   All the program matching work done for the previous edition is in a “XWALK” table. This will be the starting point for this year’s DACSO program matching work.

§  Make a copy of the “XWALK” table from the previous year (e.g.  DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_FINAL_2013_14) and rename it for the current year (e.g. DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2017_18.)

§  Open up the new XWALK table in design view and add some columns that will be used to help with the new program matching (use the current year for the variable name):

·         New_DACSO_2018

·         New_STP_2018

·         Updated_DACSO_CPC_2018

·         Updated_DACSO_CIP_2018

·         Updated_DACSO_CDTL_2018

### Find new DACSO programs

We want to find out the new DACSO programs (brand new CPCs and updated CPCs) seen since the last time we did the PSSM. These are the programs we will add to the XWALK and then need to do program matching.

### New DACSO programs that don’t have historical program linkages (brand new CPCs)

·         Change the design of **qry_DACSO_new_programs**  to use the year(s) required [[JKJ2]](#_msocom_2) to get a list of new programs (that don’t have historical program linkages[[WRM3]](#_msocom_3) ) since the last time you ran it for the PSSM to make a table for example called New_ DACSO_Programs_in_2018 [[JKJ4]](#_msocom_4) (Run qry_DACSO_new_programs.  _For example, this is selecting the programs from Infoware_Programs first seen in C_Outc18 that are not updated CPCs with historical program linkages. 85 New programs in 2018. 110 New programs in 2020 (some are same as 2018 but most are actually new)._

·         Change the design of **qry_add_new_DACSO_program_to_XWALK**  to use the DACSO new programs table you just created and make sure it is appending to this year’s XWALK table (update table name to append to). Change the Expr1 text.  Run qry_add_new_DACSO_program_to_XWALK. _For example, this is adding brand new programs seen in C_Outc18  (that don’t have any historical linkages) to the STP –DACSO xwalk table._

### New DACSO programs that have historical program linkages (updated CPCs) and were previously mapped to a STP program

1.       Change the design **qry_DACSO_updated_programs** to use the year(s) required to get a list of new programs that do have historical linkages since the last time you ran the PSSM. Change the query design to make a table for example called Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_2018. Run qry_DACSO_updated_programs .This selects the updated CPCS that are linked to historical programs. _37 programs in 2018. 93 programs in 2020._

2020 TIP: many query updates can be accomplished by copying the SQL syntax to a notepad document, and then ‘find and replace’ 2018 with 2020 and copying back to Access. Check design screen before running.

2.       Change the design of **qry_DACSO_updated_programs_links_a** to use the updated DACSO programs table you just created. Change the year(s) in the Year Link Created criteria. Change the design to make a table called for example Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_2018_with_links[[JKJ5]](#_msocom_5) . Run qry_DACSO_updated_programs_links_a . This makes a table that has the updated CPCs and their linked program ids. Note that an updated CPC may be linked to more than one historical program.

3.       You may or may not need to do this step. If Sheila (or another SO team member) has not yet added the latest year’s historical linkages to the Infoware Historical Program ID XWALK table by the time you are doing the program matching then you will need to do this step[[WRM6]](#_msocom_6) [[JKJ7]](#_msocom_7) .  Change the design of **qry_DACSO_updated_programs_links_a_step2**  to use the current Updated_DACSO_Programs_in… table and append to the latest Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_XXXX[[WRM8]](#_msocom_8) _with_links table. Change the query design to use the latest year in the PRGM_FIRST_SEEN_SUBM_CD criteria. Run qry_DACSO_updated_programs_links_a_step2

4.       In the table design view of the latest Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_XXXX_with_links table, add columns for HISTORICAL_CPC_CD, HISTORICAL_PROGRAM_NAME, and HISTORICAL_CIP4_CD

5.       Change the design of qry_DACSO_updated_programs_links_b to use the latest Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_XXXX_with_links table. Run  qry_DACSO_updated_programs_links_b to update the updated programs table with the historical program details for comparison

6.       Change the design of qry_DACSO_updated_programs_linked_STP_a to use the latest Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_XXXX_with_links  table. Change the design to make a table for example named Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_2018_linked_STP_prelim . Run qry_DACSO_updated_programs_linked_STP_a . _25_ _programs in 2018. 55 programs in 2020._

7.       Change the design of qry_DACSO_updated_programs_linked_STP_b to use the latest XWALK and Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_XXXX_linked_STP_prelim table. Run qry_DACSO_updated_programs_linked_STP_b to make a table called for example Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_2018_linked_STP_INFO. This table has the matched STP program info from last year’s XWALK table. This table will be used so that you can connect the old program info’s STP info to the related updated CPCs and update the XWALK.  _Note 46 records in 2018. 64 records in 2020._

8.       In the table design view of the latest Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_XXXX_with_links table add columns for:

a.       PSI_CODE, OUTCOMES_CRED, PSI_PROGRAM_CODE, PSI_CREDENTIAL_PROGRAM_DESC, STP_CIP4_CODE, STP_CIP4_NAME, One_To_One_Match, One_to_Many_Match, Probable_Match, Manual_Match, Extra_Flag

9.       Change the design of qry_DACSO_updated_programs_linked_STP_c to use the latest years tables. Run  qry_DACSO_updated_programs_linked_STP_c  to update the linked CPC table with the matched STP program info where there is a match for the historical program. _Updated 46 records in 2018 and 64 records in 2020._

10.   In the table design view of  the Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_XXXwith_links table add columns for:

a.       Updated_CPC_Flag

b.       Updated_CIP_Flag

11.   Change the design of  qry_DACSO_updated_programs_linked_STP_d to use the latest years tables . Run qry_DACSO_updated_programs_linked_STP_d  to update the flag indicating if it is an updated CPC. It will be Yes for all. _25 records updated in 2018. 55 records updated in 2020_

12.   Change the design of  qry_DACSO_updated_programs_linked_STP_e to use the latest years tables. Run  qry_DACSO_updated_programs_linked_STP_e  to update the flag indicating if it is an updated CIP in the updated CPC. _0 records updated in 2018, same in 2020._

**Now you are going to be able to update the matched historical programs in the STP xwalk with the updated CPC info. The other updated CPCs are for historical programs that were not previously matched to STP data and therefore they are like brand new programs but they might be matched to an STP program when you find out the new STP programs seen in this year’s STP extract.**

1.       Change the design of qry_Update_DACSO_STP_XWALK_Updated_CPCS to use the latest years tables.  Run qry_Update_DACSO_STP_XWALK_Updated_CPC.  _Updated 46 records in 2018, 64 records in 2020._

**Now you need to check the remaining DACSO updated CPCS to see if they are for programs that match an STP program.**

1.       Change the design of qry_make_Remaining_DACSO_Updated_CPCS to use the latest years tables. Run qry_make_Remaining_DACSO_Updated_CPCS to make a table for example called Remaining_DACSO_Updates_CPCS_2018 .  _N=4 in 2018, N=2 in 2020 - these don’t have historical CPCs previously matched to an STP program._  

2.       Open up the Remaining_DACSO_Updates_CPCS_XXXX table.  See if any of these updated CPCs match STP programs not previously matched. This is a manual process since the CPC codes and names aren’t exactly the same. Sometimes it was the case of an older DACSO CPC code that did not match up for some reason but now there is a newer CPC or the program is new to the XWALK (it hasn’t been used in matches before). Not totally sure what is going on but just manually went through the programs in the Remaining_DACSO_Updates_CPCS_XXXX  table to see if I could find them in previous XWALK matches as older CPCs. If yes, then I manually updated the XWALK to use the latest CPC or else I added the program as a new program to the XWALK.

3.       You may or may not need to do this step depending on whether you manually made updates in the previous step. If you want to automate the process then change the design of qry_append_updated_cpcs_not_previously_matched to use the latest years tables.  Run qry_append_updated_cpcs_not_previously_matched . Maybe these ones will end up being matched when we get to the stage of finding out the new STP program info[[WRM9]](#_msocom_9) 

### Find DACSO programs that now have updated CIPS

**Now you want to find out which DACSO programs have updated CIPs from last time the PSSM was run.**

**Open up the Infoware_Programs table to see which CPCs had an updated CIP in the latest year (Check the NOTES column to find out because this is where Sheila makes a note if the CIP was updated for a program…Hopefully they keep making note of it here!)**

·         **If I found a program with an updated CIP from the latest year then I just manually checked for these CPCS in the XWALK table (e.g. DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2015_17) and updated the CIPs manually in the XWALK table and put a “Yes” in the Updated_DACSO_CIP2015 column in the XWALK table. I probably could have figured out a query but was running out of time and it was faster just to do manually. The grayed out section below are some queries I tried as a starting point. You will need to refine them if you want to use them.**

Instead of manually updating the CIPs in the XWALK table you could try to refine/run the following to automate this stage:

·         Run **qry_Check_InfowarePrograms_Updated_CIPS_a_._** _This makes a table of the all the programs with a note that contains “CIP”.  There will be many programs that had their CIP changed in an earlier year but I had to just use “CIP” because the year that the CIP was updated may not have been noted. I don’t want to miss any programs._

·         Change the design of **qry_Check_InfowarePrograms_Updated_CIPS_b** to use the latest years tables. Run qry_Check_InfowarePrograms_Updated_CIPS_b to make a table called Infoware_Programs_UpdateCIPS_XWALK.

·         **qry_Check_InfowarePrograms_Updated_CIPS_c****[[WRM10]](#_msocom_10)** 

At this stage the XWALK table (e.g.DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2015_17) should be up to date with the latest DACSO updated program information. Note that this XWALK table was based on the one-to-one matching done for the 2013_14 PSSM. There may be DACSO programs seen but not in this table for older years if there was no match found. For the 2015_16 PSSM work, I added any new 2015, 2016 and 2017 DACSO programs. **For the 2018 PSSM work I added any new 2018 DACSO programs and re-did STP – DACSO program matching for 2002 – 2018 (focusing on 2012-2018 the most)**

The next stage to updating the XWALK is to update it with the latest STP program information.

### Find STP program information in Credential_Non_Dup

 **We need to find out the program info seen in this year’s STP Credential_Non_Dup table for DACSO records.**

·         **In the current PSSM schema in SQL server, open up the table design of the Credential_Non_Dup table and add the following columns to the Credential_Non_Dup table. These are the columns that we’ll need eventually when we are matching and figuring out the final CIP data to use:**

·         **OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4 (varchar(4))**

·         **OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4_NAME (varchar(255))**

·         **FINAL_CIP_CODE_4 (varchar(4))**

·         **FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME (varchar(255))**

·         **FINAL_CIP_CODE_2 (varchar(2))**

·         **FINAL_CIP_CODE_2_NAME (varchar(255))**

·         **FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_CODE (varchar(10))**

·         **FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_NAME (varchar(255))**

·         **STP_CIP_CODE_4 (varchar(4))**

·         **STP_CIP_CODE_4_NAME (varchar(255))**

Run **qry_Credential_Non_Dup_Add_Columns.sql** in ‘P:\PSSM\21-825-8 Post-Secondary Supply Model 2019-2020\Development\SQL Server\Outcomes Program Matching\Outcomes SQL Queries’ to add the above columns to the Credential_Non_Dup table.

ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Credential_Non_Dup]

ADD OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4 varchar(4),

 OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4_NAME varchar(255),

 FINAL_CIP_CODE_4 varchar(4),

 FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME varchar(255),

 FINAL_CIP_CODE_2 varchar(2),

 FINAL_CIP_CODE_2_NAME varchar(255),

 FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_CODE varchar(10),

 FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_NAME varchar(255),

 STP_CIP_CODE_4 varchar(4),

 STP_CIP_CODE_4_NAME varchar(255);

·         Run the SQL server query called **qry_DACSO_STP_Credential_Programs.sql**  (located in P:\PSSM\19-485-8 Post-Secondary Supply Model 2017-2018\Development\SQL Server\Outcomes Program Matching\Outcomes SQL Queries). This will make a table with the DACSO program data seen in the Credential_Non_Dup table. 4299 rows in 2018 work (note 207 programs are DACSO Outcomes Cred but from research unis), 4780 rows in 2020.

·         Open up the **STP_OutcomesProgramMatching** [[JKJ11]](#_msocom_11) Access database.

o   Import in the **STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO** from the PSSM SQL server schema and make it a local table (Access will automatically name it **dbo_STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO** because it’s a SQL table)

o   **Open up the STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO  in table design view and add columns:**

§  Already_Matched

§  New_Auto_Match

§  New_Manual_Match

o   **I added a COCI_INST_CD column to the STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO and populated it using the STP PSI CODE INST CD lookup table [[JKJ12]](#_msocom_12) because the PSI codes used in STP are different from the INST CD from outcomes data.**

UPDATE dbo_STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO

INNER JOIN tbl_STP_PSI_CODE_INST_CD_Lookup ON dbo_STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.PSI_CODE = tbl_STP_PSI_CODE_INST_CD_Lookup.PSI_CODE

SET dbo_STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.COCI_INST_CD = [tbl_STP_PSI_CODE_INST_CD_Lookup].[COCI_INST_CD];

### Find the STP programs that have already been matched in the XWALK

**These are programs with the same institution, program code and program description as programs seen in previous years.  We want to update the CIP4 because it might have changed in STP since the last cycle.**

o   Change the design of **qry_STP_Credential_DACSO_Programs_AlreadyMatched**  to use the current year’s table. Run **qry_STP_Credential_DACSO_Programs_AlreadyMatched**  to update the CIP4 for programs already in the STP DACSO XWALK that have the same PSI_CODE, PSI_PROGRAM_CODE and PSI_CREDENTIAL_PROGRAM_DESC.  _2496 records. 2421 records in 2020._

o   Change the design of **qry_STP_Credential_DACSO_Programs_AlreadyMatched_b** to use the current year’s tables. Run **qry_STP_Credential_DACSO_Programs_AlreadyMatched_b** to  update the CIP4 for programs already in the STP DACSO XWALK that have the COCI_INST_CD, PSI_PROGRAM_CODE and PSI_CREDENTIAL_PROGRAM_DESC (note that sometimes institution codes have changed over time so be aware of how that effects the matching). _~45 records in 2018, 160 in 2020._

### Find the STP programs that are new matches for the XWALK

**These are programs that have not already been matched in previous years, but there is now a new program record in the XWALK that is a match (e.g. a new DACSO program has been added to the XWALK that now matches an STP program).**

**We want to first update the STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO if there are matches to DACSO program info:**

o   **Change the design of qry_STP_Credential_DACSO_Programs_NewMatches_a to use the current year’s tables.  Run qry_STP_Credential_DACSO_Programs_NewMatches_a  to update the STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO table with new matches for programs in the STP DACSO XWALK that have the same PSI_CODE, PSI_PROGRAM_CODE and PSI_CREDENTIAL_PROGRAM_DESC. 51 + 42 records. I consider these new auto matches (because they are new and match on these three fields without requiring a manual match.**

o   **Change the design of qry_STP_Credential_DACSO_Programs_NewMatches_a_step2 to use the current year’s table. Run  qry_STP_Credential_DACSO_Programs_NewMatches_a_step2  to update STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO table with new matches for programs in the STP DACSO XWALK that have the COCI_INST_CD, PSI_PROGRAM_CODE and PSI_CREDENTIAL_PROGRAM_DESC (note that sometimes institution codes have changed over time so be aware of how that affects the matching). 75 + 1  records.**

**Now it’s time to update the XWALK table with the matched info:**

o   **Change the design of qry_STP_Credential_DACSO_Programs_NewMatches_b to use the current year’s tables. Run qry_STP_Credential_DACSO_Programs_NewMatches_b to  update the XWALK table with the new matches. 51 + 42 records.**

o   **Change the design of qry_STP_Credential_DACSO_Programs_NewMatches_b_step2 to use the current year’s tables. Run qry_STP_Credential_DACSO_Programs_NewMatches_b_step2 to update the XWALK table with the new matches. 26 records in 2018. 31 records in 2020.**

### Manually identifying the STP programs that are new matches for the XWALK

The remaining STP programs may or may not be able to be matched manually. The problem is that some institutions submit different CPC codes or program names for the same programs to DACSO and STP so the earlier queries that are trying to match on these fields won’t find them.  Also sometimes the institution codes are not consistent between STP and DACSO if institution codes have changed over time.

#### Institutions that submit different CPC codes to STP and DACSO

Each PSSM you’ll have to look at the remaining unmatched STP programs and figure out which institutions appear to be submitting different CPC and then follow the types of steps that have been done in past cycles to deal with this issue. So far the institutions with this CPC issue are: BCIT, CAP and LANG.  The types of differences and institutions involved may change each cycle so this section is guideline. You may have to modify.

This is an example of what I did using BCIT as the example:

##### **BCIT DACSO programs in STP**

**BCIT submits CPC codes to STP that include the credential abbreviation suffix (e.g. _TTDIPL, CERTTS...) but in DACSO their codes do not have the suffix.**

o   **In the table design view of the dbo_STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO add a column called BCIT_TEST_PROGRAM_CODE.**

o   **Determine what the difference is between the STP and DACSO codes and what needs to be done to make the STP code more likely to match.  Then create a query to update the test program code field. I did not save my query because it could change each time but here is what I’ve done for BCIT in the past:**

o   **Created a query that updates the BCIT_TEST_PROGRAM_CODE with the first 4 chars from the PSI_PROGRAM_CODE because this is what matches the DACSO data.** 

§  UPDATE dbo_STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO SET dbo_STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.BCIT_TEST_PROGRAM_CODE = Left([PSI_PROGRAM_CODE],4)

WHERE (([PSI_CODE]='BCIT'));

o   **Now we can try to find matches between STP and DACSO by join on BCIT_TEST_PROGRAM_CODE version of the psi_program_code:**

·         **Change the query design of qry_Update_BCIT_Programs to use the current year’s tables. Run qry_Update_BCIT_Programs to update the STP programs that match on institution, CPC and program name.**

·         **Change the query design of qry_Update_BCIT_Programs_b to use the current year’s tables. Run qry_Update_BCIT_Programs_b to update the STP programs that match on institution and program name (but not CPC)**

_***For the 2015-16 PSSM I didn’t totally realize at this point that CAP, LANG, and VIU had CPC code issues until I made a table of the remaining unmatched STP programs and investigated further. Now investigate the remaining STP new programs that have not been matched at this point to see if you can find matches.

##### **CAPU DACSO programs in STP**

CAPU submits CPC codes to STP that are 6 digits long, but in DACSO they are generally 3 or 4 digits long. 

o   In the table design view of the STP_Cred_DACSO_Programs_To_Match[[JKJ13]](#_msocom_13)  (and if needed the  dbo_STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO  table) add a column called CAP_TEST_PROGRAM_CODE.

o   Determine what the difference is between the STP and DACSO codes and what needs to be done to make the STP code more likely to match.  Then create a query to update the test program code field. I did not save my query because it could change each time but here is what I’ve done for CAP in the past:

§  Created a query that updates the CAP_TEST_PROGRAM_CODE with the first 3 chars from the PSI_PROGRAM_CODE because this is what matches the DACSO data. 

·         UPDATE dbo_STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO SET dbo_STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.CAP_TEST_PROGRAM_CODE = Left([PSI_PROGRAM_CODE],3)

WHERE (([PSI_CODE]='CAPU'));

§  If there were some 4-digit CPC codes in DACSO I just manually updated the CAP_TEST_PROGRAM_CODE.[[JKJ14]](#_msocom_14)

Run qry_Update_CAPU_Programs  to update the STP programs that match on institution and CPC. _Matched 34 more programs._ These are new STP psi-program_codes not seen but when you take the first 3 chars they are ones that were matched previously to DACSO programs.

LANG submits CPC codes to STP that are longer than in DACSO. In STP the codes repeat the program code twice in the CPC, but not in DACSO. (E.g. NURS.000000NURS in STP, but NURS.000000 in DACSO). Unfortunately the program names are also slightly different.

For 2018 PSSM work there were N= 167 [[WRM20]](#_msocom_20) programs with a CIP4 from outcomes that was different from the STP CIP4. 21 institutions with differences and across a variety of programs.

****SUMMARY of PSSM  2017-2018 program matching for STP to DACSO**  
N=4090 non research university programs in  PSSM’s STP Credential Non Dup program DASCO table.**

**In the end after doing all my program matching for this year…of the N=4090 DACSO programs in STP, I was able to match 3391 (83%) of them to DACSO.  Of the n=3391, there were 167 (5 %) programs that had different CIP4s between STP and DACSO. They were from a variety of institutions and program types. Of the 167, 91 had a CIP2 change. See the table called STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_CIPS_CHANGED_2018  in the Access program matching database for details.**

**_**SUMMARY of PSSM  2015-2016 program matching for STP to DACSO**  
N=2510 programs in last PSSM’s STP Credential Non Dup program DASCO table._**

**_N=3790 in this year’s STP Credential Non Dup program DACSO table but there are some programs from ECU and research universities that made it into this table because they had and OUTCOMES CRED =DACSO(based on credential category – see table called CredentialGrouping). I need to check out the query used to create the DACSO programs list from STP to modify it to exclude non-DACSO institutions._**

**_When I remove the ECU and research universities’ programs there are N=3593 programs. This is higher than last time because there are also more blank PSI_PROGRAM_CODES.  PSI_PROGRAM_CODE had to be populated based on matching the STP enrolment and STP credential files.  In past years probably the enrolment and/or credential program information came from one source, but with the two  files created separately there are a lot of program name/program code differences between the enrolment and the credential files. I think that this is the reason why there are more programs in the list and why some of my previous years’ program matching work wasn’t useful because suddenly we are seeing different program names, etc. so matching queries don’t pick on the slight differences._**

**_In the end after doing all my program matching for this year…of the N=3593 DACSO programs in STP, I was able to match 2733 (75%) of them to DACSO.  Of the n=2733, there were 177 (6 %) programs that had different CIP4s between STP and DACSO. They were from a variety of institutions and program types. Of the 177, 92 had a CIP2 change. See the table called STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_CIPS_CHANGED_2015_17_FINAL  in the Access program matching database for details._**

Now you are ready to update the Credential_Non_Dup table CIP information for DACSO records:

·         Import the dbo_STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO back into SQL server.

o   Name the table Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_FinalCIPS.

·         Run the update query in the outcomes matching.txt to update the DACO records in the STP_Credential_Non_Dup table with the final CIP info from the DACCO program matching work. Updated 397825 DACSO records.

·         To see a count of all the CIP information:

SELECT        OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4, OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4_NAME, FINAL_CIP_CODE_4, FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME, FINAL_CIP_CODE_2, FINAL_CIP_CODE_2_NAME,

                         FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_CODE, FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_NAME, STP_CIP_CODE_4, STP_CIP_CODE_4_NAME, OUTCOMES_CRED, COUNT(*) AS Expr1,

                         RESEARCH_UNIVERSITY

FROM            Credential_Non_Dup

GROUP BY OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4, OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4_NAME, FINAL_CIP_CODE_4, FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME, FINAL_CIP_CODE_2, FINAL_CIP_CODE_2_NAME,

                         FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_CODE, FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_NAME, STP_CIP_CODE_4, STP_CIP_CODE_4_NAME, OUTCOMES_CRED, RESEARCH_UNIVERSITY

HAVING        (OUTCOMES_CRED = 'DACSO') AND (RESEARCH_UNIVERSITY IS NULL)

*****Note: We only do one-way CIP changes for DACSO. That is, we do the matching between STP and DACSO programs and if we find a program match and the CIPs differ then we change the STP to use the DACSO CIP. There are no instances where we change the DACSO CIP to match the STP CIP if there is a difference. Our logic is that the DACSO data has more recent CIPS (because of the time lag between when the STP data is pulled and sent to us, and when the DACSO program review and cohort loading happens.) Also the DACSO data undergoes the extensive program review. So there is no need to make any CIP changes in the DACSO data table from outcomes. *** This is different from BGS where we sometimes change the STP CIP to match the BGS and vice versa, depending on which CIP we think is more appropriate/detailed etc.*****

·         The columns called OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4 and OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4_NAME are populated if we were able to match in some form to get the outcomes CIP. It’s null if the STP record was not able to be matched to DACSO. The FINAL_CIP_CODE_4 and FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME columns are the final CIPs to use. They are populated with the Outcomes CIP info if available, and with the STP CIP info for the remaining records.

_**Note I made a new Access database with all the final DACSO program matching tables, STP XWALK and queries called STP_DACSO_ProgramMatching_Final2015_16.accdb. There were so many other old tables and queries in the STP_OutcomesProgramMatching db from the old method and it was getting confusing. Also I think it would be less cluttered to have separate program matching databases for DACSO, APPSO and BGS.***_

_Steps still to do for 2015-16 but I think it’s just about updating the XWALK table because I’ve updated the DACSO CIP data in the STP credential non dup table at this point. I did it through a SQL query rather then all the access queries to update the final cips. Because this time I had only program information to match not unique IDs per student._

_qry_append_new_STP_matches_for_XWALK to append the new manual matches to the XWALK table._

_Use the Access database STP_Assign_Final_CIPS. Import the DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2013_14 table from your outcomes matching database. Link to the latest Credential_Non_Dup table._

_qry_Credential_Non_Dup_DACSO_with_ProgramInfo_a. This makes a table with the DASCO records that have non-null program information_

_Make ID the primary key in the resulting table_

_qry_Credential_Non_Dup_DACSO_with_ProgramInfo_b.  This updates the Outcomes CIP CODE 4 and Name columns with the outcomes CIP information for records in STP programs that were matched to DACSO programs in the XWALK table._

_Note that you need to populate the STP CIP CODE 4 and Name columns with the 4-digit version of the STP’s PSI_CREDENTIAL_CIP without the periods. I didn’t save the query for this.  It’s easy to join to the Infoware CIP 2011 6 digits table to do this. But note that there are some records that only have a 2 digit or 4-digit PSI_CREDENTIAL_CIP so you will need to assign the CIP code 4 for these by a bit of work around._

_qry_Update_STP_Credential_Non_Dup_DACSO_finalCIP_a. This query assigns the outcomes CIP to the final CIP code 4_

_The remaining records that weren’t matched will need to be assigned the STP assigned CIP code in the FINAL_CIP_CODE_4 and other FINAL CIP code columns.  If there was an Outcomes CIP code assigned then that will be populated into the FINAL CIP code columns. So the final CIP code columns reflect a combination of Outcomes CIPs where there was a match otherwise the STP assigned CIP info._

_qry_Update_STP_Credential_Non_Dup_DACSO_finalCIP_b_

_Assigns the STP CIP code 4 to the final CIP code 4 column where there was not an outcomes CIP for the STP program_

_Back in SQL Server import the Credential_Non_Dup_DACSO_with_ProgramInfo table and the infoware CIP lookup tables_

_Run the update code to update the Credential_Non_Dup table:_

_UPDATE    Credential_Non_Dup_

_SET              FINAL_CIP_CODE_4 = Credential_Non_Dup_DACSO_with_ProgramInfo.FINAL_CIP_CODE_4,_

                      _FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME = Credential_Non_Dup_DACSO_with_ProgramInfo.FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME,_

                      _OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4 = Credential_Non_Dup_DACSO_with_ProgramInfo.OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4,_

                      _OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4_NAME = Credential_Non_Dup_DACSO_with_ProgramInfo.OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4_NAME,_

                      _STP_CIP_CODE_4 = Credential_Non_Dup_DACSO_with_ProgramInfo.STP_CIP_CODE_4,_

                      _STP_CIP_CODE_4_NAME = Credential_Non_Dup_DACSO_with_ProgramInfo.STP_CIP_CODE_4_NAME_

_FROM         Credential_Non_Dup INNER JOIN_

                      _Credential_Non_Dup_DACSO_with_ProgramInfo ON Credential_Non_Dup.id = Credential_Non_Dup_DACSO_with_ProgramInfo.id_

_qry_Update_STP_Credential_Non_Dup_DACSO_finalCIP_c_

_Now you need to assigns the STP CIP code 4 to the final CIP code 4 column where there was no program information to match so just need to use the STP assigned CIP._

_Run the code:_

_UPDATE    Credential_Non_Dup_

_SET              FINAL_CIP_CODE_4 = STP_CIP_CODE_4, FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME = STP_CIP_CODE_4_NAME_

_WHERE     (OUTCOMES_CRED = 'DACSO') AND (FINAL_CIP_CODE_4 IS NULL) AND (FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME IS NULL)_

_Based on the FINAL_CIP_Code_4 data assign the CIP code 2 and CIP cluster columns by joining to the Infoware CIP look up tables._

_UPDATE    Credential_Non_Dup_

_SET              FINAL_CIP_CODE_2 = INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2011.LCP2_CD, FINAL_CIP_CODE_2_NAME = INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2011.LCP2_DIGITS_NAME,_

                      _FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_CODE = INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2011.LCP2_LCIPPC_CD,_

                      _FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_NAME = INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2011.LCP2_LCIPPC_NAME_

_FROM         Credential_Non_Dup INNER JOIN_

                      _INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2011 ON Credential_Non_Dup.FINAL_CIP_CODE_4 = INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2011.LCIP_LCP4_CD INNER JOIN_

                      _INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2011 ON INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2011.LCIP_LCP2_CD = INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2011.LCP2_CD_

_WHERE     (Credential_Non_Dup.OUTCOMES_CRED = 'DACSO')_

_Update the CIP cluster code for remaining records:_

_UPDATE    Credential_Non_Dup_

_SET              FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_CODE = INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2011.LCP2_LCIPPC_CD,_

                      _FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_NAME = INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2011.LCP2_LCIPPC_NAME_

_FROM         Credential_Non_Dup INNER JOIN_

                      _INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2011 ON Credential_Non_Dup.FINAL_CIP_CODE_2 = INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2011.LCP2_CD_

_WHERE     (Credential_Non_Dup.OUTCOMES_CRED = 'DACSO') AND (Credential_Non_Dup.FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_CODE IS NULL)_

_Now the DACSO data in the STP credential non dup table is completed with the CIP coding._

These had a null PSI_CE_CRS_ONLY and null PSI_CIP_CODE so I think that's how they snuck in. Will need to remember to add query criteria to exclude these records from the final credential counts._ _[[WRM21]](#_msocom_21)_

_SELECT     FINAL_CIP_CODE_4, FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME, STP_CIP_CODE_4, STP_CIP_CODE_4_NAME, OUTCOMES_CRED, COUNT(*)_

_FROM         Credential_Non_Dup_

_GROUP BY FINAL_CIP_CODE_4, FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME, STP_CIP_CODE_4, STP_CIP_CODE_4_NAME, OUTCOMES_CRED_

_HAVING      (FINAL_CIP_CODE_4 <> STP_CIP_CODE_4) AND (OUTCOMES_CRED = 'DACSO')__[[WRM22]](#_msocom_22)_

# FILE: 02a-dacso-program-matching.R
# ==============================================================================
# ── PIPELINE POSITION ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Script:      02a-dacso-program-matching.R
# Stage:       Program matching / DACSO
# Runs after:  after 01c and DACSO load
# Key inputs:  Credential_Non_Dup; DACSO program tables
# Key outputs: DACSO/STP program match outputs
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Matches DACSO programs to STP and prepares DACSO CIP updates.
# 📌 CONTEXT: Current PSSM processing uses R, SQL Server on decimal, and LAN files.
#             Access, Citrix, and \alder\S52018$ are historical references only.
# ⚠️ NOTE: This combined file is a reference document; run source scripts through
#          the orchestrator or documented sequence, not as one monolithic script.

# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations under the License.

# ******************************************************************************
# Aligns CIP codes between DACSO and STP data
#
# Required Tables
#   DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_20XX (previous PSSM XWALK)
#   INFOWARE_PROGRAMS
#   INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016
#   INFOWARE_L_CIP_4DIGITS_CIP2016
#   INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2016
#   INFOWARE_PROGRAMS_HIST_PRGMID_XREF
#   Credential_Non_Dup
#
# Resulting Tables
#   Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_FinalCIPS
#   DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_20XX (current PSSM XWALK)
#
# STEPS:
# Setup: import and save required tables
#
# Part 1: Add DACSO programs to XWALK
# Part 2: Add STP programs to XWALK
# Part 3: Manual/custom STP to XWALK matching
# Part 4: Final update to STP CIPs
#
# ******************************************************************************

library(tidyverse)
library(RODBC)
library(config)
library(glue)
library(odbc)
library(RJDBC) ## loads DBI

# Setup ----

## ---- Read in INFOWARE tables ----
iw_config <- config::get("infoware")
jdbc_config <- config::get("jdbc")

jdbcDriver <- JDBC(jdbc_config$class, classPath = jdbc_config$path)

iw_con <- dbConnect(
  jdbcDriver,
  iw_config$database,
  iw_config$uid,
  iw_config$pwd
)

INFOWARE_PROGRAMS <- dbReadTable(iw_con, "INFOWARE.PROGRAMS")
INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016 <- dbReadTable(
  iw_con,
  "INFOWARE.L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016"
)
INFOWARE_L_CIP_4DIGITS_CIP2016 <- dbReadTable(
  iw_con,
  "INFOWARE.L_CIP_4DIGITS_CIP2016"
)
INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2016 <- dbReadTable(
  iw_con,
  "INFOWARE.L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2016"
)
INFOWARE_PROGRAMS_HIST_PRGMID_XREF <- dbReadTable(
  iw_con,
  "INFOWARE.PROGRAMS_HIST_PRGMID_XREF"
)

dbDisconnect(iw_con)

## ---- Read in last years XWALK ----
## connect to outcomes (access) database
connection <- config::get("connection")$outcomes_dacso
acc_con <- odbcDriverConnect(connection)

DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2020 <- sqlQuery(
  acc_con,
  "SELECT * FROM DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2020;"
)

odbcClose(acc_con)

## ---- Connect to Decimal ----
config <- config::get("decimal")
con <- dbConnect(
  odbc(),
  Driver = config$driver,
  Server = config$server,
  Database = config$database,
  Trusted_Connection = "True"
)
my_schema <- config::get("myschema")

## ---- Write initial tables to Decimal ----
## Save static versions of the INFOWARE tables and last cycle XWALK to Decimal
dbWriteTable(
  con,
  SQL(glue::glue('"{my_schema}"."DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2020"')),
  DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2020
)
dbWriteTable(
  con,
  SQL(glue::glue('"{my_schema}"."INFOWARE_PROGRAMS"')),
  INFOWARE_PROGRAMS
)
dbWriteTable(
  con,
  SQL(glue::glue('"{my_schema}"."INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016"')),
  INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016
)
dbWriteTable(
  con,
  SQL(glue::glue('"{my_schema}"."INFOWARE_L_CIP_4DIGITS_CIP2016"')),
  INFOWARE_L_CIP_4DIGITS_CIP2016
)
dbWriteTable(
  con,
  SQL(glue::glue('"{my_schema}"."INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2016"')),
  INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2016
)
dbWriteTable(
  con,
  SQL(glue::glue('"{my_schema}"."INFOWARE_PROGRAMS_HIST_PRGMID_XREF"')),
  INFOWARE_PROGRAMS_HIST_PRGMID_XREF
)

## remove tables and use decimal versions for remainder of code
rm(
  DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2020,
  INFOWARE_PROGRAMS,
  INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016,
  INFOWARE_L_CIP_4DIGITS_CIP2016,
  INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2016,
  INFOWARE_PROGRAMS_HIST_PRGMID_XREF
)

# Part 1 ----

## ---- Create programs_table from combining INFOWARE tables ----
## define programs_table from which to grab new programs (with and without historical linkages)
programs_table <- tbl(con, "INFOWARE_PROGRAMS_2016") %>%
  inner_join(
    tbl(con, "INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016"),
    by = c("LCIP_CD_CIP2016" = "LCIP_CD")
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    tbl(con, "INFOWARE_L_CIP_4DIGITS_CIP2016"),
    by = c("LCIP_LCP4_CD" = "LCP4_CD")
  ) %>%
  select(
    PRGM_ID,
    PRGM_FIRST_SEEN_SUBM_CD,
    PRGM_INST_CD,
    PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME,
    PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME_CLEANED,
    PRGM_LCPC_CD,
    PRGM_TTRAIN_FLAG,
    LCIP_CD_CIP2016,
    LCIP_NAME_CIP2016,
    PRGM_CREDENTIAL,
    NOTES,
    HAS_HISTORICAL_PRGM_ID_LINK,
    CIP_CLUSTER_ARTS_APPLIED,
    DACSO_OLD_PRGM_ID_DO_NOT_USE,
    DUP_PROGRAM_USE_THIS_PRGM_ID,
    LCIP_LCP4_CD,
    LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME
  ) %>%
  collect()

## ---- Make new XWALK from last years XWALK ----
DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23 <- tbl(
  con,
  "DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2020"
) %>%
  collect() %>%
  mutate(CIP_CODE_4 = str_pad(CIP_CODE_4, width = 4, side = "left", pad = "0"))

## ---- Add to XWALK: New DACSO prgms WITHOUT historical linkages ----
## review the HAS_HISTORICAL_PRGM_ID_LINK values
programs_table %>%
  filter(PRGM_FIRST_SEEN_SUBM_CD %in% c('C_Outc21', 'C_Outc22', 'C_Outc23')) %>%
  group_by(PRGM_FIRST_SEEN_SUBM_CD, HAS_HISTORICAL_PRGM_ID_LINK) %>%
  tally()

new_dacso_programs_21_23 <- programs_table %>%
  filter(
    PRGM_FIRST_SEEN_SUBM_CD %in%
      c('C_Outc21', 'C_Outc22', 'C_Outc23') &
      (is.na(HAS_HISTORICAL_PRGM_ID_LINK) | HAS_HISTORICAL_PRGM_ID_LINK == " ")
  )
new_dacso_programs_21_23 %>% count(PRGM_FIRST_SEEN_SUBM_CD)

DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23 <- DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23 %>%
  bind_rows(
    programs_table %>%
      filter(
        PRGM_FIRST_SEEN_SUBM_CD %in%
          c('C_Outc21', 'C_Outc22', 'C_Outc23') &
          (is.na(HAS_HISTORICAL_PRGM_ID_LINK) |
            HAS_HISTORICAL_PRGM_ID_LINK == " ")
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        New_DACSO_Program2021_23 = case_when(
          PRGM_FIRST_SEEN_SUBM_CD == "C_Outc21" ~ "Yes2021",
          PRGM_FIRST_SEEN_SUBM_CD == "C_Outc22" ~ "Yes2022",
          PRGM_FIRST_SEEN_SUBM_CD == "C_Outc23" ~ "Yes2023"
        )
      ) %>%
      select(
        COCI_INST_CD = PRGM_INST_CD,
        PRGM_LCPC_CD,
        PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME,
        CIP_CODE_4 = LCIP_LCP4_CD,
        LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME,
        PRGM_ID,
        PRGM_CREDENTIAL,
        New_DACSO_Program2021_23
      )
  )

# The following steps are repeated for each year since last PSSM:
##  Find DACSO prgms WITH historical linkages
##  Get historical linkages for DACSO prgms
##  Update to XWALK: Updated DACSO programs WITH historical linkages
##  Find Remaining updated DACSO missing from XWALK for match to STP program

## ---- 2021 Find DACSO prgms WITH historical linkages ----
Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_2021_with_links <- programs_table %>%
  filter(
    PRGM_FIRST_SEEN_SUBM_CD == 'C_Outc21' & HAS_HISTORICAL_PRGM_ID_LINK == 'Y'
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    tbl(con, "INFOWARE_PROGRAMS_HIST_PRGMID_XREF") %>%
      filter(YEAR_LINK_CREATED == 'C_Outc21' & SURVEY_CODE == 'DACSO') %>%
      collect(),
    by = "PRGM_ID"
  ) %>%
  select(
    PRGM_ID,
    PRGM_FIRST_SEEN_SUBM_CD,
    PRGM_INST_CD,
    PRGM_LCPC_CD,
    PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME,
    PRGM_TTRAIN_FLAG,
    PRGM_CREDENTIAL,
    PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME_CLEANED,
    NOTES,
    HAS_HISTORICAL_PRGM_ID_LINK,
    DUP_PROGRAM_USE_THIS_PRGM_ID,
    CIP_CLUSTER_ARTS_APPLIED,
    DACSO_OLD_PRGM_ID_DO_NOT_USE,
    LCIP_CD_CIP2016,
    LCIP_NAME_CIP2016,
    LCIP_LCP4_CD,
    LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME,
    HISTORICAL_PRGM_ID,
    YEAR_LINK_CREATED,
    SURVEY_CODE
  )

## ---- 2021 Get historical linkages for DACSO prgms ----
## use the historical linkage added from INFOWARE_PROGRAMS_HIST_PRGMID_XREF
## to link back to the programs table to fill in the historical program details
Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_2021_with_links <- Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_2021_with_links %>%
  inner_join(
    programs_table %>%
      select(
        PRGM_ID,
        HISTORICAL_CPC_CD = PRGM_LCPC_CD,
        HISTORICAL_PROGRAM_NAME = PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME,
        HISTORICAL_CIP4_CD = LCIP_LCP4_CD
      ),
    by = c(HISTORICAL_PRGM_ID = "PRGM_ID")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Updated_CPC_Flag = case_when(
      PRGM_LCPC_CD != HISTORICAL_CPC_CD ~ 'Yes',
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    Updated_CIP_Flag = case_when(
      LCIP_LCP4_CD != HISTORICAL_CIP4_CD ~ 'Yes',
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  )

## ---- 2021 Update to XWALK: Updated DACSO programs WITH historical linkages ----
DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23 <- DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23 %>%
  left_join(
    Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_2021_with_links %>%
      mutate(HISTORICAL_CPC_CD = as.character(HISTORICAL_CPC_CD)) %>%
      select(
        PRGM_INST_CD,
        HISTORICAL_CPC_CD,
        HISTORICAL_PROGRAM_NAME,
        HISTORICAL_CIP4_CD,
        PRGM_LCPC_CD,
        PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME,
        LCIP_LCP4_CD,
        LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME,
        Updated_DACSO_CPC2021 = Updated_CPC_Flag,
        Updated_DACSO_CIP2021 = Updated_CIP_Flag
      ),
    by = c(
      COCI_INST_CD = "PRGM_INST_CD",
      PRGM_LCPC_CD = "HISTORICAL_CPC_CD",
      PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME = "HISTORICAL_PROGRAM_NAME",
      CIP_CODE_4 = "HISTORICAL_CIP4_CD"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    PRGM_LCPC_CD = ifelse(!is.na(PRGM_LCPC_CD.y), PRGM_LCPC_CD.y, PRGM_LCPC_CD),
    PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME = ifelse(
      !is.na(PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME.y),
      PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME.y,
      PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME
    ),
    CIP_CODE_4 = ifelse(!is.na(LCIP_LCP4_CD), LCIP_LCP4_CD, CIP_CODE_4)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME = ifelse(
      !is.na(LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME.y),
      LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME.y,
      LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME.x
    ),
    .after = "CIP_CODE_4"
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".x"), -ends_with(".y"), -LCIP_LCP4_CD)

## ---- 2021 Find Remaining updated DACSO missing from XWALK for match to STP program ----
Remaining_DACSO_Updates_CPCS_2021 <- Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_2021_with_links %>%
  anti_join(
    DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23,
    by = c(
      PRGM_LCPC_CD = "PRGM_LCPC_CD",
      PRGM_INST_CD = "COCI_INST_CD",
      PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME = "PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME"
    )
  )

# ***** manual work needed *****
# review infoware notes
programs_table %>%
  filter(PRGM_ID %in% Remaining_DACSO_Updates_CPCS_2021$PRGM_ID) %>%
  pull(PRGM_ID, NOTES)

# PRGM_ID 10132 links to 3119
programs_table %>% filter(PRGM_ID == "3119") %>% pull(NOTES)

# update based on review
DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23 <- DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23 %>%
  mutate(
    CIP_CODE_4 = case_when(PRGM_ID == 3119 ~ "1907", TRUE ~ CIP_CODE_4),
    LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME = case_when(
      PRGM_ID ==
        3119 ~ "Human development, family studies and related services",
      TRUE ~ LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME
    ),
    Updated_DACSO_CIP2021 = case_when(
      PRGM_ID == 3119 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ Updated_DACSO_CIP2021
    ),
    PRGM_LCPC_CD = case_when(PRGM_ID == 3119 ~ "EACSW", TRUE ~ PRGM_LCPC_CD),
    PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME = case_when(
      PRGM_ID == 3119 ~ "Education Assistant and Community Support Worker",
      TRUE ~ PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME
    ),
    Updated_DACSO_CPC2021 = case_when(
      PRGM_ID == 3119 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ Updated_DACSO_CPC2021
    )
  )

# 7 PRGM_IDs remaining CPCs had historical links for their historical links
##  i.e., they could be linked to more codes back
# review notes for each historical, to find the last historical link:
# 10355 -> 9855 -> 115 (update CIP and CPC to most recent)
# 10359 -> 9856 -> 9006 -> 4760 (4760 doesn't exist in XWALK, update 9006 - CPC & CIP)
# 10366 -> 9859 -> 5952 -> 116 (116 doesn't exist in XWALK, update 5952 - CPC only)
# 10367 -> 9858 -> 9008 (update CPC only)
# 10383 -> 9857 -> 4960 (update CPC only)
# 10387 -> 9860 -> 117 (update CPC only)
# 10399 -> 9861 -> 131 (update CIP and CPC to most recent)

# apply necessary updates

  mutate(

      PRGM_ID == 115 ~ "1502",
      PRGM_ID == 9006 ~ "1110",

      TRUE ~ LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME
    ),

      PRGM_ID == 115 ~ "Yes",
      PRGM_ID == 9006 ~ "Yes",
      PRGM_ID == 131 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ Updated_DACSO_CIP2022
    ),
    PRGM_LCPC_CD = case_when(
      PRGM_ID == 115 ~ "CENG.DIP",
      PRGM_ID == 9006 ~ "CNET.CERT",
      PRGM_ID == 5952 ~ "ECENG.RE.DIP",
      PRGM_ID == 9008 ~ "ECENG.UVIC.ADIP",
      PRGM_ID == 4960 ~ "ICS.DIP",
      PRGM_ID == 117 ~ "MENG.DIP",
      PRGM_ID == 131 ~ "VART.DIP",
      TRUE ~ PRGM_LCPC_CD
    ),
    PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME = case_when(
      PRGM_ID == 115 ~ "Civil Engineering Technology (Diploma)",
      PRGM_ID ==
        9006 ~ "Computer Network Electronics Support Tech (Certificate)",
      PRGM_ID ==
        5952 ~ "Electronics & Computer Eng - Renewable Energy (Diploma)",
      PRGM_ID ==
        9008 ~ "Electrical & Computer Eng - Bridge to UVic (Adv Diploma)",
      PRGM_ID == 4960 ~ "Information & Computer Systems Technology (Diploma)",
      PRGM_ID == 117 ~ "Mechanical Engineering Technology (Diploma)",
      PRGM_ID == 131 ~ "Visual Arts (Diploma)",
      TRUE ~ PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME
    ),
    Updated_DACSO_CPC2022 = case_when(
      PRGM_ID == 115 ~ "Yes",
      PRGM_ID == 9006 ~ "Yes",
      PRGM_ID == 5952 ~ "Yes",
      PRGM_ID == 9008 ~ "Yes",
      PRGM_ID == 4960 ~ "Yes",
      PRGM_ID == 117 ~ "Yes",
      PRGM_ID == 131 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ Updated_DACSO_CPC2022
    )
  )

        PRGM_ID,

        HISTORICAL_PROGRAM_NAME = PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME,
        HISTORICAL_CIP4_CD = LCIP_LCP4_CD
      ),
    by = c(HISTORICAL_PRGM_ID = "PRGM_ID")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Updated_CPC_Flag = case_when(
      PRGM_LCPC_CD != HISTORICAL_CPC_CD ~ 'Yes',
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    Updated_CIP_Flag = case_when(
      LCIP_LCP4_CD != HISTORICAL_CIP4_CD ~ 'Yes',
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  )

## ---- 2023 Update to XWALK: Updated DACSO programs WITH historical linkages ----
DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23 <- DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23 %>%
  left_join(
    Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_2023_with_links %>%
      mutate(HISTORICAL_CPC_CD = as.character(HISTORICAL_CPC_CD)) %>%
      select(
        PRGM_INST_CD,
        HISTORICAL_CPC_CD,
        HISTORICAL_PROGRAM_NAME,
        HISTORICAL_CIP4_CD,
        PRGM_LCPC_CD,
        PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME,
        LCIP_LCP4_CD,
        LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME,
        Updated_DACSO_CPC2023 = Updated_CPC_Flag,
        Updated_DACSO_CIP2023 = Updated_CIP_Flag
      ),
    by = c(
      COCI_INST_CD = "PRGM_INST_CD",
      PRGM_LCPC_CD = "HISTORICAL_CPC_CD",
      PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME = "HISTORICAL_PROGRAM_NAME",
      CIP_CODE_4 = "HISTORICAL_CIP4_CD"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    PRGM_LCPC_CD = ifelse(!is.na(PRGM_LCPC_CD.y), PRGM_LCPC_CD.y, PRGM_LCPC_CD),
    PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME = ifelse(
      !is.na(PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME.y),
      PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME.y,
      PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME
    ),
    CIP_CODE_4 = ifelse(!is.na(LCIP_LCP4_CD), LCIP_LCP4_CD, CIP_CODE_4)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME = ifelse(
      !is.na(LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME.y),
      LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME.y,
      LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME.x
    ),
    .after = "CIP_CODE_4"
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".x"), -ends_with(".y"), -LCIP_LCP4_CD)

## ---- 2023 Find Remaining updated DACSO missing from XWALK for match to STP program ----
Remaining_DACSO_Updates_CPCS_2023 <- Updated_DACSO_Programs_in_2023_with_links %>%
  anti_join(
    DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23,
    by = c(
      PRGM_LCPC_CD = "PRGM_LCPC_CD",
      PRGM_INST_CD = "COCI_INST_CD",
      PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME = "PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME"
    )
  )

# ***** manual work needed *****
# review infoware notes
programs_table %>%
  filter(PRGM_ID %in% Remaining_DACSO_Updates_CPCS_2023$PRGM_ID) %>%
  pull(PRGM_ID, NOTES)
# 3 PRGM_IDs remaining CPCs
# 1 linked to multiple historic codes: 10413 -> 9841 -> 9237 -> 9017 -> 6036 (9017 & 6036 doesn't exist in XWALK, update 9237 - CPC only)
# 1 was updated by 2022 update (10234 updated the CPC): 10475 -> 1158 (update CPC only)
# 1 has historical match not in XWALK: 10493 -> 9810 (9810 does not exist in XWALK - add 10493 info as 9810 PRGM_ID)

# add missing PRGM_ID
DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23 <- DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23 %>%
  bind_rows(
    Remaining_DACSO_Updates_CPCS_2023 %>%
      filter(PRGM_ID == "10493") %>%
      mutate(
        PSI_CODE = PRGM_INST_CD,
        COCI_INST_CD = PRGM_INST_CD,
        PSI_PROGRAM_CODE = PRGM_LCPC_CD,
        PSI_CREDENTIAL_PROGRAM_DESC = PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME,
        PRGM_ID = 9810,
        New_DACSO_Program2021to23 = "Yes2023"
      ) %>%
      select(
        PSI_CODE,
        COCI_INST_CD,
        PSI_PROGRAM_CODE,
        PSI_CREDENTIAL_PROGRAM_DESC,
        PRGM_LCPC_CD,
        PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME,
        PRGM_CREDENTIAL,
        CIP_CODE_4 = LCIP_LCP4_CD,
        LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME,
        PRGM_ID,
        New_DACSO_Program2021to23
      )
  )

# update necessary values
DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23 <- DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23 %>%
  mutate(
    PRGM_LCPC_CD = case_when(
      PRGM_ID == 9237 ~ "BCPRPC",
      PRGM_ID == 1158 ~ "DIPLHKIN",
      TRUE ~ PRGM_LCPC_CD
    ),
    PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME = case_when(
      PRGM_ID ==
        9237 ~ "BC Police Recruit Training: Qualified Municipal Constable",
      PRGM_ID == 1158 ~ "Human Kinetics",
      TRUE ~ PRGM_INST_PROGRAM_NAME
    ),
    Updated_DACSO_CPC2023 = case_when(
      PRGM_ID == 9237 ~ "Yes",
      PRGM_ID == 1158 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ Updated_DACSO_CPC2023
    )
  )

## ---- Update to XWALK: DACSO programs with updated CIPS ----
## find the updated CIPs
updated_cips <- DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23 %>%
  left_join(
    programs_table %>%
      select(PRGM_ID, CIP_CODE_4 = LCIP_LCP4_CD, LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME, NOTES),
    by = "PRGM_ID"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    CIP_CODE_4.x != CIP_CODE_4.y |
      LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME.x != LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME.y
  )

# filter out the known updates
updated_cips <- updated_cips %>%
  filter(
    is.na(Updated_DACSO_CIP2021) &
      is.na(Updated_DACSO_CIP2022) &
      is.na(Updated_DACSO_CIP2023)
  )

# review NOTES column where word "CIP" exists
updated_cips %>%
  filter(grepl("CIP", NOTES)) %>%
  select(CIP_CODE_4.x, CIP_CODE_4.y, NOTES, PRGM_ID) %>%
  print(n = 100)

# review NOTES column where word "CIP" doesn't exist
updated_cips %>%
  filter(!grepl("CIP", NOTES)) %>%
  select(CIP_CODE_4.x, CIP_CODE_4.y, NOTES, PRGM_ID) %>%
  print(n = 100)

updated_cips %>%
  filter(!grepl("CIP", NOTES)) %>%
  select(LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME.x, LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME.y, NOTES, PRGM_ID) %>%
  print(n = 100)

# Decision: PRGM_ID 9018 shouldn't be changed; the rest seem like acceptable changes
# filter out from updated cips file
updated_cips <- updated_cips %>%
  filter(PRGM_ID != 9018)

# update CIPS in XWALK
DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23 <- DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23 %>%
  left_join(
    updated_cips %>%
      distinct(
        PRGM_ID,
        CIP_CODE_4 = CIP_CODE_4.y,
        LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME = LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME.y
      ),
    by = "PRGM_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CIP_CODE_4 = ifelse(!is.na(CIP_CODE_4.y), CIP_CODE_4.y, CIP_CODE_4.x),
    LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME = ifelse(
      !is.na(LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME.y),
      LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME.y,
      LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME.x
    ),
    # adding all of these to only the most recent year updated cip column
    Updated_DACSO_CIP2023 = ifelse(
      !is.na(CIP_CODE_4.y),
      "Yes",
      Updated_DACSO_CIP2023
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".x"), -ends_with(".y"))

dbWriteTable(

)

## ---- Make STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO ----
# Create a DACSO version of Credential_non_dup table with subset of columns

# [SELECT INTO] Create STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO from Credential_Non_Dup
# ******************************************************************************
# ---- Part 1: Update XWALK with new DACSO data ----
# All SQL queries replaced with R code

## qry_DASCO_STP_Credential_Programs ----
qry_DASCO_STP_Credential_Programs <-
  "SELECT PSI_CODE, PSI_PROGRAM_CODE, PSI_CREDENTIAL_PROGRAM_DESCRIPTION, PSI_CREDENTIAL_CIP,
       PSI_CREDENTIAL_LEVEL, PSI_CREDENTIAL_CATEGORY, OUTCOMES_CRED, COUNT(*) AS Expr1
INTO   STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO
FROM   Credential_Non_Dup
GROUP BY PSI_CODE, PSI_PROGRAM_CODE, PSI_CREDENTIAL_PROGRAM_DESCRIPTION, PSI_CREDENTIAL_CIP,
         PSI_CREDENTIAL_LEVEL, PSI_CREDENTIAL_CATEGORY, OUTCOMES_CRED
HAVING OUTCOMES_CRED = 'DACSO'"
dbGetQuery(con, qry_DASCO_STP_Credential_Programs)

## ---- Restructure and populate imported STP data ----

# [ALTER TABLE] STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO

## qry_DASCO_STP_Credential_Programs_Add_Columns ----
qry_DASCO_STP_Credential_Programs_Add_Columns <-
  "ALTER TABLE STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO
ADD
 OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4 varchar(4),
 OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4_NAME varchar(255),
 FINAL_CIP_CODE_4 varchar(4),
 FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME varchar(255),
 FINAL_CIP_CODE_2 varchar(2),
 FINAL_CIP_CODE_2_NAME varchar(255),
 FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_CODE varchar(10),
 FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_NAME varchar(255),
 STP_CIP_CODE_4 varchar(4),
 STP_CIP_CODE_4_NAME varchar(255),
 Already_Matched VARCHAR(255),
 New_Auto_Match VARCHAR(255),
 New_Manual_Match VARCHAR(255),
 COCI_INST_CD VARCHAR(255)"
dbGetQuery(con, qry_DASCO_STP_Credential_Programs_Add_Columns)

# Create PSI_CODE to COCI_INST_CD lookup table
dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT DISTINCT PSI_CODE, COCI_INST_CD
           INTO tbl_STP_PSI_CODE_INST_CD_Lookup
           FROM DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23
           WHERE PSI_CODE IS NOT NULL and COCI_INST_CD IS NOT NULL"
)

# Add COCI_INST_CD to STP table
dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "UPDATE STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO 
SET STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.COCI_INST_CD = tbl_STP_PSI_CODE_INST_CD_Lookup.COCI_INST_CD
FROM STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO INNER JOIN tbl_STP_PSI_CODE_INST_CD_Lookup 
ON STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.PSI_CODE = tbl_STP_PSI_CODE_INST_CD_Lookup.PSI_CODE"
)

## ---- Populate STP_CIP_CODE_4, STP_CIP_CODE_4_NAME ----
# [UPDATE] STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO: add STP CIP codes from INFOWARE
qry_Update_STP_CIP_CODE4 <-
  "UPDATE STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO
  SET STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.STP_CIP_CODE_4 = [INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016].[LCIP_LCP4_CD],
STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.STP_CIP_CODE_4_NAME = [INFOWARE_L_CIP_4DIGITS_CIP2016].[LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME]
FROM INFOWARE_L_CIP_4DIGITS_CIP2016 INNER JOIN (STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO
INNER JOIN INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016
ON STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.PSI_CREDENTIAL_CIP = INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016.LCIP_CD_WITH_PERIOD)
ON INFOWARE_L_CIP_4DIGITS_CIP2016.LCP4_CD = INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016.LCIP_LCP4_CD"
dbGetQuery(con, qry_Update_STP_CIP_CODE4)

(STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.PSI_CODE = DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23.PSI_CODE
)"

SET
  STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.Already_Matched = 'Yes',

FROM STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO INNER JOIN DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23

  STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.COCI_INST_CD = DACSO_STP_ProgramsCIP4_XWALK_ALL_2021_23.COCI_INST_CD) AND

qry_Update_STP_Cred_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_FinalCIP4_b <-
  "UPDATE STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO
SET STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_4 = [INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016].[LCIP_LCP4_CD],
STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME = [INFOWARE_L_CIP_4DIGITS_CIP2016].[LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME],

STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_2_NAME = [INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2016].[LCP2_DIGITS_NAME]
  FROM (STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO INNER JOIN (INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016 INNER JOIN INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2016
  ON INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016.LCIP_LCP2_CD = INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2016.LCP2_CD)
  ON STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.PSI_CREDENTIAL_CIP = INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016.LCIP_CD_WITH_PERIOD)
  INNER JOIN INFOWARE_L_CIP_4DIGITS_CIP2016
  ON INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016.LCIP_LCP4_CD = INFOWARE_L_CIP_4DIGITS_CIP2016.LCP4_CD
WHERE (((STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_4) Is Null)
AND ((STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME) Is Null)
AND ((STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_2) Is Null)
AND ((STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_2_NAME) Is Null)
AND ((STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4) Is Null)
AND ((STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4_NAME) Is Null))"
dbGetQuery(con, qry_Update_STP_Cred_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_FinalCIP4_b)

# [UPDATE] STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO

## qry_Update_STP_Cred_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_FinalCIP4_c ----
qry_Update_STP_Cred_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_FinalCIP4_c <-
  "UPDATE STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO
  SET STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME = [INFOWARE_L_CIP_4DIGITS_CIP2016].[LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME],
  STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_2 = [INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016].[LCIP_LCP2_CD],
  STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_2_NAME = [INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2016].[LCP2_DIGITS_NAME]
FROM STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO INNER JOIN ((INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016 INNER JOIN INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2016
ON INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016.LCIP_LCP2_CD = INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2016.LCP2_CD) INNER JOIN INFOWARE_L_CIP_4DIGITS_CIP2016
ON INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016.LCIP_LCP4_CD = INFOWARE_L_CIP_4DIGITS_CIP2016.LCP4_CD)
ON STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_4 = INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016.LCIP_LCP4_CD
WHERE (((STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME) Is Null)
AND ((STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_2) Is Null)
AND ((STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_2_NAME) Is Null)
AND ((STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4) Is Null)
AND ((STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4_NAME) Is Null))"
dbGetQuery(con, qry_Update_STP_Cred_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_FinalCIP4_c)

# To update the final cip 2 and  final cip cluster based on the final cip4

# [UPDATE] STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO

## qry_Update_STP_Cred_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_FinalCIP2_Cluster_a ----
qry_Update_STP_Cred_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_FinalCIP2_Cluster_a <-
  "UPDATE STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO
  SET STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_2 = [INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016].[LCIP_LCP2_CD],
STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_CODE = [INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016].[LCIP_LCIPPC_CD],
STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CLUSTER_NAME = [INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016].[LCIP_LCIPPC_NAME]
FROM STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO INNER JOIN INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016
ON STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_4 = INFOWARE_L_CIP_6DIGITS_CIP2016.LCIP_LCP4_CD"
dbGetQuery(con, qry_Update_STP_Cred_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_FinalCIP2_Cluster_a)

# To update the final cip 2 name based on the final cip2

# [UPDATE] STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO

## qry_Update_STP_Cred_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_FinalCIP2_Cluster_b ----
qry_Update_STP_Cred_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_FinalCIP2_Cluster_b <-
  "UPDATE STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO
  SET STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_2_NAME = [INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2016].[LCP2_DIGITS_NAME]
FROM STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO INNER JOIN INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2016
  ON STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_2 = INFOWARE_L_CIP_2DIGITS_CIP2016.LCP2_CD
WHERE (((STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_2_NAME) Is Null))"
dbGetQuery(con, qry_Update_STP_Cred_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_FinalCIP2_Cluster_b)

# check the # of changed CIPS

# [SELECT INTO] Create STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_CIPS_CHANGED_2021_23 from STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO

## qry_Check_CIP_Changes_STP_Cred_Non_Dup_DACSO ----
qry_Check_CIP_Changes_STP_Cred_Non_Dup_DACSO <-
  "SELECT PSI_CODE, PSI_PROGRAM_CODE, PSI_CREDENTIAL_PROGRAM_DESCRIPTION, PSI_CREDENTIAL_CIP,
STP_CIP_CODE_4, STP_CIP_CODE_4_NAME, OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4, OUTCOMES_CIP_CODE_4_NAME, FINAL_CIP_CODE_4, FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME,
Already_Matched, New_Auto_Match, New_Manual_Match, COCI_INST_CD
INTO STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_CIPS_CHANGED_2021_23
FROM STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO
WHERE (((STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.FINAL_CIP_CODE_4)<>STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO.STP_CIP_CODE_4))"
dbGetQuery(con, qry_Check_CIP_Changes_STP_Cred_Non_Dup_DACSO)
nrow(
  tbl(con, "STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_CIPS_CHANGED_2021_23") %>%
    collect()
)
review_changed_cips <- tbl(
  con,
  "STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_CIPS_CHANGED_2021_23"
) %>%
  collect()

## Save to new table in DECIMAL: Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_FinalCIPS ----
dbExecute(
  con,
  "SELECT * 
               INTO Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_FinalCIPS
               FROM STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO;"
)

# Clean up ----
dbExecute(con, "DROP TABLE tbl_STP_PSI_CODE_INST_CD_Lookup")
dbExecute(
  con,
  "DROP TABLE STP_Credential_Non_Dup_Programs_DACSO_CIPS_CHANGED_2021_23"
)
dbDisconnect(con)

# ==============================================================================

---
